findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrutica_search, scrutica_get_facility, scrutica_query_export_controls, scrutica_entity_list_changes, scrutica_get_supply_chain, scrutica_get_scenario, scrutica_get_methodology · Private data: scrutica_get_facility, scrutica_get_company, scrutica_entity_list_changes, scrutica_get_supply_chain, scrutica_get_sovereign_program · Public sink: scrutica_get_supply_chain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrutica_search, scrutica_get_facility, scrutica_query_export_controls, scrutica_entity_list_changes, scrutica_get_supply_chain, scrutica_get_scenario, scrutica_get_methodology · Private data: scrutica_get_facility, scrutica_get_company, scrutica_entity_list_changes, scrutica_get_supply_chain, scrutica_get_sovereign_program · Public sink: scrutica_get_supply_chain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
